name: stateseal
description: Read-only runtime panorama and Skill attribution for coding agents

interface.shortDescription: Read-only Agent runtime panorama and attribution.
interface.longDescription: StateSeal reconstructs Agent sessions, Skill usage, tool activity, artifacts, failures, and reported outcomes from local runtime signals. It never starts, steers, blocks, approves, or applies Agent work.
defaultPrompt: Explain which Skills and tools were observed
Diagnose this Agent session without changing it
